prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin to establish rules on which kinds of change work or fail, as each kind of change has only one test so far.
Predictions were consistently too high: both tests predicted positive gains (+14.0% and +6.0%), but both resulted in negative outcomes (-7.2% after noise correction).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: -7.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -7.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, redesign] Interactive Desktop Placement Preview: Redesigns the final intro screen with a simulated desktop view stage so users can test dragging, placing, and summoning their pet before completing onboarding. (why: Support receives multiple emails about pets not appearing on the desktop, and the finish step conversion drops to 64.8% with high completion time.)
1: [adoption, redesign] Preset Pet Selection Speed Run: Redesigns the friend selection screen into a split view with fast preset pet archetypes and instant preview cards. (why: Adoption stage has low conversion (60.9%) and long duration (median 89s / mean 1017s), alongside reported custom generation failures.)
2: [adoption, new_flow] Express Naming and Personality Sub-Flow: Inserts a dedicated name input and mood selection screen between choosing a friend and certificate generation. (why: Adoption process takes a very long time (1017s mean), causing drop-off before adoption completion.)
3: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Background Entertainment: Adds an interactive tip carousel, progress bar, and estimated time remaining during the pet generation wait screen. (why: The waiting step has the longest mean duration (2336s), causing users to abandon or assume the app froze.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Stalling Diagnostic Assistant: Adds explicit connection tips and an immediate retry button if authentication takes more than a few seconds. (why: Support received reports of sign-in screens not appearing or stalling before completion, contributing to 72.9% step conversion.)
5: [sign_in, incentive] Clear Cloud Account Benefit Badge: Displays a prominent cloud sync guarantee badge above sign-in options explaining how accounts protect pets across reinstalls. (why: Top support theme (8 emails) is pets missing or reset after users sign in again on a different session.)
6: [choose_path, notification] Onboarding Duration and Step Indicator Bar: Adds explicit step counter and total time estimate indicators to the top of early onboarding screens. (why: Overall onboarding finish rate is only 17.8%, with long mean times creating dropoff due to unclear duration.)
7: [home, wait_info] Generation Sound and Status Cue: Adds visual progress status cues and ready sound notifications to the waiting stage before moving to home. (why: Home waiting step has a high mean duration (2336s) where users switch away from the desktop app and miss completion.)
